description: Facebook 584 — 98 patches with Vietnamese UI, Following feed by default, save photos by default + hide tab bar on the Reels tab (on by default; hiding gives the bar's space back, a tap or swipe brings it back for three seconds; 0.17.8: giving the space back is re-asserted on every layout pass from the bar's own tree — the live pager is found from the bar and its bottom padding, and its pages', is taken again whenever Facebook settles it back — and the Reels page's own header hides too, on its own switch in Appearance, its height collapsed so reels get that space, back for three seconds on a touch) + experimental: push the video to the top when comments open (settings > Comments) + split the screen half and half when comments open, EXTENDED in 0.17.8 (the Hook diagnostics row proved the in-place controller path is never reached on the test phone — zero calls while real comments opened — so the half cap now also stands on the surfaces that phone can take: the regular comment sheet, its share capped where its parameters are built and its window height capped at both places the popover fragment settles it, the fixed eight-tenths box a full share falls back to included; and the video platform's split screen, its sheet height capped where it is handed to the sheet's component. The five split-screen launchers and the comment views setup only report that they ran, so the Hook diagnostics row — itself extended with the hunt's last-seen shares, ratio and heights — can say which surface a phone really opens comments through; on by default, settings > Comments). FITTED in 0.17.9: capping the sheet still left the video full-screen behind it, its lower half hidden under the sheet, so while a comment sheet is open the playing video's container is now settled into exactly the space the sheet leaves — the page's width, from the page's top down to the sheet's top edge — and the player re-fits the whole frame inside it, centred, as large as its aspect allows; closing the sheet gives the container back + tab bar background more transparent, about half of Facebook's own alpha (on by default, settings > Appearance; 0.17.9: on the Reels tab the bar's fills are fully transparent and the opaque backgrounds of the pager, the Reels page and the bar's frame are cleared, while the reel's video container is lengthened to the bottom of the screen, so a reel runs to the bottom edge under the bar) + the Hook diagnostics row (settings > Pause, backup and diagnostics); quiet preset. FIXED in 0.17.10: the Hook diagnostics row on 0.17.9 proved both 0.17.9 mechanisms never once fired on the test phone, for landscape and portrait videos alike — the video fit's hunt never recorded a container, and the bottom clearing stood at 'not applied yet'. The hunt is rewritten: any video surface at least half the window's width and a twelfth of its height is a candidate now (the first shape demanded near half the window's height, which a 16:9 player — a strip a quarter of the window tall — can never meet), scored by the part of it on screen, walked as deep as the activity's content tree asks from the comment fragment's own activity (so Reels, Watch and feed players are all covered), and retried on the sheet window's own draws for about two seconds instead of three fixed delays; when it still does not land, the diagnostics row says how many tries it made, the largest surface it met and why it stopped. The bottom clearing now leaves its reason as its state at every way out (not the Reels tab, the switch off, no pager found), takes any kind of background rather than only a plain colour, adds the tab bar's ancestors on the way to the window, and the video's distance to the bottom of its page and of the window is measured on every Reels pass in either state of the bar, so the band's own numbers are always on the row. FIXED in 0.17.11: the 0.17.10 measured fit was real and invisible - the diagnostics row read the video container taken from 2107px to exactly the region's 1187px, fitted and restored once each, and the phone's screen never moved: Facebook's layout took the params back within a pass or two, and the hold stood on the sheet window's tree, not the activity's where the container lives. The comments fit no longer touches the layout at all: the found container keeps Facebook's own layout and is drawn into the region above the comment sheet by a uniform scale about its top centre (factor = the region's height over the container's own height), translated so its top rests on the region's top and its centre on the region's centre - the player renders the whole frame into its surface and the surface is drawn at the scale, so the whole frame stands inside the region with nothing cropped and no layout pass able to settle it back. A guard on the activity decor's layout passes watches the drawn box while the sheet is open and scales afresh from a clean identity measurement when the box is out of place, re-hunting (throttled) if the page rebuilt the container; closing the sheet restores the found transform exactly. Diagnostics keeps the scale factor and the drawn top/bottom against the region's, sticky. The Reels bottom numbers are sticky too: the clear keeps its last conclusion reached on the Reels tab (with its cleared count) instead of being overwritten by whatever tab the row is read from, the locate walk runs on the hunt's full 60000-node budget and caches the container between passes so the bottom gaps are measured as designed, and the bottom work climbs past the page - the first box from the page upward whose bottom stops short of the window's bottom is lengthened to the window's bottom (bottom margin given back first, an exact height grown by the rest; a box whose params hold nothing hands the climb to its parent and the passes converge level by level), its class name and total lengthened px kept on the diagnostics row, its found params restored on leaving the tab. Scope: layout-made black only - a 16:9 frame's own letterbox on a portrait page is aspect, not layout, and is not cropped away. FITTED TO THE FRAME in 0.17.13: the scale fitted the container, a portrait box whose landscape frame is only a strip letterboxed in its middle, so a 16:9 video came out at about a third of the area it could have had, floating mid-region. The fit now measures the picture itself - the frame as the player draws it, its surface sized to the frame and centred in its box by the player's own resize - and scales by the picture's fit into the region, the smaller of the region's shares of its width and of its height, set at the region's top and centred across it: a 16:9 frame in the phone's region takes no scale at all and lands whole at its full width, a portrait frame is fitted by the region's height. The guard above the sheet watches the picture's drawn box now, and the diagnostics row gains the picture's own line - its size and place before the fit, the box it was fitted to, and the shape it was read from. + NEW in 0.17.12: 'Swipe up or down on the mini player to switch videos' - a hard fling up on the small floating player a video shrinks into plays the next video in its chain and a hard fling down goes back to the one before, through the chain's own stock advance; the extension keeps the session's history itself, so going forward again replays what was stepped back over before new videos are taken from the chain. Dragging the player, tapping it and weaker flings stay stock. On by default; switch in Hushfacebook settings > Playback. The Hook diagnostics page gains the family's block, including whether the server gave the player a chaining session at all and the chain queue's size at the last sighting. + CHANGED in 0.17.14: the mini player swipe answers an ordinary swipe — the fling gate drops from the gesture listener's dismiss threshold (the device's minimum fling velocity scaled by fourteen) to its lower fling threshold (scaled by four), and a firm vertical drag released past half the player's height turns the same page, with the player's drag frozen from the moment the gesture locks vertical, on the enlarged player as on the small one. The Hook diagnostics block keeps the largest fling speed that ever reached the hook and the threshold it was judged against, and counts a switch by fling, a switch by drag and a strong vertical gesture that met neither bar separately. + DISCOVERY in 0.17.15: the Hook diagnostics row on 0.17.14 read the mini player swipe family's hooks called zero times on the test phone while the neighbouring families lived — the chained WatchAndGo player those hooks stand on never opens there. This build carries more than one mini player under one window manager, and which one a phone gets is the launch's choice: the chained player is built only for the launches that carry a chaining session with them, and the rest are handed one of the other managers the app's own wiring provides — a Litho mini player whose view's own touch listener answers nothing, so its taps and drags are settled inside its Litho tree, or the gaming player that floats an instant game. The swipe patch now also stands at the one door every mini player of the family walks through — the window manager's attach, counted under the name of the manager it serves — and counts the gestures that reach the other players' touch listeners, and the family's diagnostics block names the manager that last opened a window, sticky, so one screenshot of the row says which surface the phone really uses and where its touches land. The probe changes nothing it touches, and the swipe itself is unchanged.
